# Cinder Rail

Experimental HTTP 402 compute sandbox. No real payments or token.

- [Console](/)
- [Developer guide](/developers)
- [API catalog](/api/catalog)
- [Issuer public key](/api/key)
- [Architecture](/docs/architecture.md)
- [Security](/docs/security.md)

Protocol is cinder-sandbox-v1, not x402 wire compatible. Denomination sandbox-microUSD is nonredeemable test accounting. Agent keys ECDSA P-256; provider receipt signatures certify provenance, not inference correctness.
